why: The conjecture is a family of restriction-problem statements across group types, and several specific cases have been proved since Jan 2024: the (U(2n),U(1)) case and its GL split analogue with Ichino-Ikeda refinement (2025), the non-tempered Archimedean GL case reportedly settled (2025), and a Fourier-Jacobi periods case for unitary groups (paper revised Jan 2026).

found.title: On the Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture and its refinement for (U(2n),U(1))
found.note: Proves the (U(2n),U(1)) case and its refinement, plus the split GL analogue; published in Mathematische Annalen.

found.title: The local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for GL(V)/U(V)
found.note: Preprint on a local twisted case of the conjecture; not read.

found.title: The global Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for Fourier–Jacobi periods on unitary groups II: Comparison of the relative trace formulae
found.note: Second/third paper in a series (started 2024-04) proving a Fourier-Jacobi periods case with Ichino-Ikeda refinement; preprint, not read.

found.title: Rankin-Selberg integrals for GSpin groups with application to the global Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture
found.note: Proves one direction of the global conjecture for quasi-split GSpin groups; preprint, not read.

found.title: Special periods and some non-tempered cases of the Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture
found.note: Preprint on non-tempered cases; not read.
